transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We're doing our routine pre-publication check-in for the catalog. I'd like to focus on 'Glass Harbor' — the current draft lists it at 94 minutes with premiere status still marked for confirmation. I need submissions and technical screening to report any status or master-file issues so I can make the final programming and delivery decision. Can we start with what each of you has on this title?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding your catalog review has not refreshed, so that's why the premiere status is still marked for confirmation.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94-minute catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and has not yet been attached to the programming record.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the runtime from 94 minutes to 88 minutes and update premiere status from 'for confirmation' to 'not a national premiere' based on confirmed prior public screening at Coastline Film Week.
Assign 'Glass Harbor' to the panorama program, as it is not eligible for national competition due to prior public screening in this country.
Use the approved 88-minute festival cut DCP confirmed by Elise's QC report for all screenings. Attach the QC report to the programming record.
